Traditions

One combined celebration, bringing together two beautiful traditions

Gol Dhana

A traditional Gujarati engagement ceremony where the couple exchanges rings to finalize their commitment. The name translates to "jaggery and coriander seeds," distributed to guests to symbolize sweetness and prosperity for the couple's future.

Sakhar Puda

The traditional Maharashtrian engagement ceremony marking a formal verbal agreement between both families. The name translates to "sugar packet," symbolizing a sweet beginning as the groom's family gifts sugar, a saree, and green bangles to the bride, often accompanied by a modern ring exchange.
